---
title: "Neighborhood Analysis Invasive Species"
author: "Jenny Hansen"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rgrass)

# connect to GRASS
NinaR::grassConnect(location = "ETRS_32N", mapset = "p_Restaurerbar_Akershus")

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Akershus fylke
akershus <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/AdministrativeUnits/Norway_AdministrativeUnits/Original/Norway_County/versjon2024/Administrative_enheter_fylker_2024_FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_Fylker2024_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fylke")
write_VECT(vect(akershus), "akershus_vect")

# invasive spp.
invasive_spp <- read.csv("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Artsobservasjoner/Fremmedarter/artsobs_fremmed.csv") %>% 
  filter(county == "Akershus") %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("X_32", "Y_32"), crs = 25832)
write_VECT(vect(invasive_spp), "invasive_vect", flags = "overwrite")
```

Set up GRASS environment

```{r echo=FALSE}

execGRASS("g.region", vector = "akershus_vect", flags = "p", res = "10")
execGRASS("g.remove", type = "raster", name = "MASK", flags = "f")

```

Rasterize invasive species

```{r echo=FALSE}

# rasterize features
execGRASS("v.to.rast",
          input = "invasive_vect",
          output = "invasive_rast",
          use = "val",
          value = 1,
          type = "point", 
          flags = c("overwrite", "quiet"))

# ensure NULL is 0 
execGRASS(
  "r.mapcalc",
  flags = c("overwrite", "quiet"),
  expression = "invasive_rast = if(isnull(invasive_rast), 0, 1)"
)
```

Moving window neighborhood analysis

```{r echo=FALSE}

# using a 9-cell (3x3) window
execGRASS("r.neighbors",
          input = "invasive_rast",
          output = "invasive_rast_sum",
          method = "sum",
          size = 3,
          flags = c("overwrite", "quiet"))

```

Apply mask and import/write

```{r echo=FALSE}

execGRASS("r.mask", vector = "akershus_vect")

invasive_neighborhood <- read_RAST("invasive_rast_sum")
plot(invasive_neighborhood) # max 4/cell
writeRaster(invasive_neighborhood, "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/invasive_neighborhood.tif")
```
